definitions.Math-to-Pack Handoff: AVAILABLE_MATH / PACKER_BUSY * 100 when PACKER_BUSY > 0; this is a handoff ratio, not an issue count
definitions.instrn_availability_note: Instruction availability is pending-in-buffer time, not issue rate.

counters.serialization_conclusion: Half-sync reduced both semaphore wait percentages at the selected fastest rows (Zero T2 79.42% to 64.06%; Full T1 16.90% to 3.69%), but Pack Idle Wait T2 increased 1.44% to 3.02% and the handoff ratio remained above 100%. It relieved semaphore synchronization pressure, but these fastest rows use different matrix blocks, so the counters do not establish that half-sync alone relieved hardware math/pack serialization or caused the throughput result.
limitations: The official counter captures are one-launch multipass diagnostics, not throughput samples.
RISC-V brackets around tile_regs_* are not interpreted as hardware DEST-wait measurements.
No issue count is inferred from instruction availability.

environment.harness_capture_note: The transferred source tree was clean at the recorded commit; .git was excluded from the board staging copy, so the commit is carried from the synchronized source revision.

conclusion.throughput_comparison: The fastest measured full-sync row was faster than the fastest measured half-sync row in this manifest; no default change is justified by this comparison.
conclusion.scope: This record covers the selected BF16-rounded-R inverse workload only, not end-to-end image quality.

notes: All 46 admitted-row Watcher correctness cases passed the 0.01 gate; nine requested rows were not measured because DEST or L1 preflight rejected them.
Every accepted row has 1,000 launch samples with p50, p99, p99.9, p50-derived TFLOPS, and fastest-launch TFLOPS.
The record omits the machine name/hostname and user-specific paths; board identifiers retained for provenance follow ADR-0005.
